title: The Cascade of Stress: A Network Approach to Explore Differential Dynamics in Populations Varying in Risk for Psychosis
limitations: - Limited to 13 variables due to variable selection criteria; - Medication status not available for all studies; - Group average estimates used, not personalized networks; - No confidence intervals provided due to computational demands of permutation testing.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. Code and data are declared available in supplementary materials, but specific links are not provided in the text. The authors used permutation testing for significance, which is computationally intensive and does not allow for standard confidence intervals.
